The source is a textured AlN film, sample E. The primary article reports slightly nitrogen-rich nonstoichiometry and derives c=0.5031 nm from the (0002) peak; complete refinement of a and the atomic u parameter was not demonstrated. Full occupation in the deposited CIF alone does not resolve this material-model discrepancy.
